descriptionChirho: The proper noun עֲנָתוֹת designating the Levitical city in the territory of Benjamin, most famously the hometown of the prophet Jeremiah (Jer 1:1, 11:21, 29:27, 32:7-9) and also associated with Abiathar's exile (1 Kgs 2:26) and post-exilic returnees (Ezra 2:23, Neh 7:27, 11:32, Isa 10:30). All three clusters are the same toponym with varying prepositional prefixes. Multilingual evidence: English 'Anathoth/Anatot,' Spanish 'Anatot,' Hindi अनातोत, Arabic عَنَاثُوت (consistent across all clusters), Korean 아나돗/아나맷, Swahili Anathothi. The conjunctive 'and Anathoth' (S125470) and directional 'to Anathoth' (S125469) are syntactic, not semantic, variations of the same place name.
